description: The bundled UI in the main window: events, the identity status (no signer on this build), whether notifications are allowed (the notification plugin's own page script asks), and the QR scanner (the camera's standing, a scan, its cancel, and the app's page in Settings when the camera is refused; not the plugin's vibrate: a scan's haptic is app_haptic's). Notifications are posted by Rust. No remote block, ever.
